title: Even throughout the pullback, my AI-managed "Public Portfolio Challenge" is still beating the market!
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
I created the [Public Portfolio Challenge](https://nexustrade.io/shared-portfolio/69a7dc7cf99e43688fcec567), a challenge where I give over $25,000 to an AI agent and have it trade options. It includes stocks like SpaceX, XOM, and ANET. Despite being a long-only portfolio with calls on highly volatile stocks, I'm still doing *fairly* well; I've lost a LOT from my peak, but I'm still outperforming the broader market wholeheartedly. 

If you want to see how I built this portfolio, check it out on my [blog](https://nexustrade.io/blog/series/public-portfolio-challenge) or check-out the [open-source GitHub repo!](https://github.com/austin-starks/public-portfolio-challenge)
